WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    sp.zoneref,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) FILTER (WHERE sp.remaingb IS NOT NULL) as avg_remain_gb,
    AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) FILTER (WHERE sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL) as avg_cpu_gpu_gap
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
mean_remaining AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remain_gb) as mean_avg_remain_gb
  FROM group_stats
  WHERE avg_remain_gb IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  gs.zoneref,
  gs.insurstat,
  gs.avg_remain_gb,
  gs.avg_cpu_gpu_gap,
  gs.avg_remain_gb / m.mean_avg_remain_gb as ratio
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN mean_remaining m
WHERE m.mean_avg_remain_gb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
